text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
After all, together we're running the 
Twinkle Series, so we're buddies, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I want to know more about you, 
and you need to learn more about me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I want to spend more time with you. 
I need to experience lots of things. ——Don't you think so?

And so, the day of the party arrived. 
I had my outfit in hand and was making my way to the venue……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Nervous?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No surprise there. ……But, don't worry. 
After all is said and done, today is a 『Theme Party』!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Once we're on site and changed in to our 『Spy』 outfits, I'm sure 
the excitement will make you forget all about that! ……We're fine!
Even though she said all that……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
——Wow. 
Looks like a cute little rat snuck its way in.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Checkmate——Just kidding! Sorry for the wait, Trainer! 
Oh! Aren't you the perfect 『Office Worker-style Spy』♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu, 『Hotelier』! 
Quite the unexpected choice, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Heart! That person next to you, are they 
the rumored trainer? Nice to meet you～! And, Cheers☆

……The number of attendees was more than I expected. 
I was a little worried I was in over my head……

text_block_list.name: Loudspeaker
text_block_list.text: (Sirens)

text_block_list.name: Organizer Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone! Since everyone's here, 
the 『Best Agent-Look Contest』 will begin!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: 『Best Agent-Look Contest』. Like a 『Disguise Contest』

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Using props alongside your costume, 
disguise in a manner to complete your 『Mission』!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I plan on entering, how about you?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm entering too～! Trainer-san, 
how about you? Entering? You gonna enter too!?

……To be honest, I'm not very good with being in 
front of a crowd. But since I'm Daring Heart's trainer……

text_block_list.name: Organizer Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Next! Agent Daring Heart's 『Mission』 
……『A Sheltered Lady from a Wealthy Family』!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good day, everyone. 
To commemorate our meeting, allow me to play a song.
(Gii-Gii-Gii)

text_block_list.name: Organizer Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
But you can hardly play! ……moving on, next! 
The next Agent is that young lady's trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Organizer Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
This Agent's mission is——『The Rising Star——A Top Idol』! 
Then, if you please!

As my nervousness peaked, I heard a calm voice in the back of my mind. 
……『If you're going to stumble, then stumble forward』
choice_data_list: ——Everyone! I finally get to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow…
choice_data_list: You're not leaving tonight…… Let's run together!
You're not leaving tonight…… Let's run together!

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: Kyaa-! So cool～♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……Oh, my gosh. You are an eager beaver. 
You're quite the hard worker.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fancy that! You were able to do something like that. 
Everyone was really fired up.
choice_data_list: Ahaha…… I'm glad they enjoyed it

text_block_list.text:
That said, it had all been extremely mentally 
and physically draining. I just wanted to relax but……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If it's like usual, then up next is Dance Time. 
I'm going to join in, but you can get some rest……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What? 
But aren't you already exhausted?
choice_data_list: ……I just thought I should get used to it

text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I would have to be able 
to handle this kind of event regularly……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
——No. 
I'm thankful, but no thanks to that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I told you when I invited you, didn't I? 
My goal today was just 『Mutual Understanding』

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What's important is for you to understand. 
It's not to make you push yourself to try and have fun together.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……If you head back inside, I'm sure you'll be 
able to spend a more relaxed time. And you'll 
still be able to see how things go from in there.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's fine if you take a little break. 
——Thanks for doing your best for this long!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Heart, you already changed. 
Where are you going? Toilet?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Non. Just a little tired so I'm gonna take short break. 
See ya in a bit.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ——Alright, then……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there they are. 
……Oh——Hmmm?

I listened to the hustle and bustle of 
the gathering as I went over my notebook……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
『Based on their appearance, A seems to have a sports background. 
Quite skilled too. Doesn't quite fit as an Ordinary Person』

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
『B puts a lot of attention in to their outfit. A perfectionist—— 
Or perhaps just well-versed? Might be a good conversation starter』

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Is this perhaps, an analysis of the participants?

At first I was just observing…… but at some point it seems 
like I switched in to Analysis mode without realizing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm shook…

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
This is unbelievable! 
It's amazing, Trainer! It's all correct!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A is that girl in the one-piece dress, right? 
She has a black belt in judo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And B is that girl right? She's a huge fan of Spy movies. 
She even cosplays in her everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You got all this just from observing?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm excited! 
It's almost like you're a real Agent!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Any others? If you don't mind, I'd like to see 
you analyze a few more! Let's see how close you get!
choice_data_list: Forget about me, what about the party?
Forget about me, what about the party?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're thickheaded about the weirdest things, you know? 
With those analytical eyes, I want you to look at me more.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was able to learn a lot about you. How observant 
you are, and the way you tend to push yourself hard.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why, you should look at me too? 
You know what I mean.

With just a wink, the unease in my heart just melted away. 
Before I realized it, the corners of my mouth had naturally lifted.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu, were you able to find your answer? 
Then, let's compare them! Ace Agent-san♪
